skill.name: creating-skills
skill.description: Guide for creating Claude Code skills with clear frontmatter, concise workflows, helper script guidance, and quality checks.
skill.summary: Create well-structured Claude Code skills with practical templates and review guidance.
skill.author: Bae-ChangHyun

security_audit.summary: The static command and filesystem findings are false positives caused by Markdown examples, inline code spans, and standard Claude skills directory documentation. One semantic concern remains: the guide encourages broad Bash wildcard permissions, which can lead authors to grant generated skills more command access than necessary.

remediation.suggestion: Replace broad patterns such as Bash(git *) and Bash(npm *) with task-specific allowlists, and explain when broad patterns are unsafe.

remediation.issue: Setup examples write into the Claude skills directory
remediation.suggestion: Add a short reminder before copy-paste setup commands that the user should approve writes to ~/.claude/skills.

semantic_findings.title: Overbroad Bash Permission Guidance
semantic_findings.description: The guide recommends wildcard Bash permissions such as Bash(git *), Bash(npm *), and Bash(mkdir *) for cleaner permissions. Generated skills could receive broader command access than needed.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The text directly recommends broad wildcard permission patterns and labels them cleaner. This is legitimate documentation, but it can weaken least-privilege controls in generated skills.

content.value_statement: Building a useful AI skill requires clear triggers, structure, and guardrails. This guide helps authors draft concise Claude Code skills with examples and quality checks.
actual_capabilities: Explains required SKILL.md frontmatter and description structure.
Provides a starter directory layout for Claude Code skills.
Shows when helper scripts are useful for structured processing.
Defines naming, token budget, and progressive disclosure guidance.
Includes a quality checklist for reviewing a skill before release.
limitations: Does not generate or validate a complete skill package automatically.
Does not test whether a skill triggers correctly inside Claude Code.
Does not include marketplace packaging or publishing automation.
Permission examples need stricter least-privilege guidance before reuse.

use_cases.title: Draft a First Skill
use_cases.description: Create a clean SKILL.md outline with required metadata, a short workflow, and focused rules.

use_cases.title: Review Skill Structure
use_cases.description: Check an existing skill for naming, trigger phrases, token budget, and section order.

use_cases.title: Plan Supporting References
use_cases.description: Decide which examples, guides, or helper scripts belong outside the main skill file.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Basic Skill
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the creating-skills guide to draft a SKILL.md for a skill that helps with [task]. Include frontmatter, a quick start, and core rules.

prompt_templates.title: Improve an Existing Draft
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my SKILL.md using the creating-skills checklist. Identify unclear triggers, extra detail, missing sections, and permission risks.

prompt_templates.title: Split Detailed References
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me reorganize this long skill. Keep SKILL.md under 500 lines and move detailed examples into reference files.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Skill Suite
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a set of related Claude Code skills for [domain]. Recommend names, descriptions, shared references, helper scripts, and review criteria.

output_examples.input: I need a skill for creating release notes from merged pull requests.
output_examples.output: A concise skill outline with a release-notes name, trigger-focused description, quick start, workflow steps, helper script guidance, and review checklist.

output_examples.input: This skill file is too long and includes many examples.
output_examples.output: A restructure plan that keeps the main workflow short and moves extended examples, troubleshooting, and background material into references.

output_examples.input: Check whether my skill follows Claude Code conventions.
output_examples.output: A review summary covering frontmatter, naming, trigger phrases, line count, helper script value, and permission guidance.

best_practices: Write descriptions with what the skill does, when to use it, and key capabilities.
Keep SKILL.md focused, and move long examples into reference files.
Require confirmation before file changes, destructive commands, or external resource creation.
anti_patterns: Creating wrapper scripts for simple commands that the agent can run directly.
Adding broad background explanations that do not change the agent workflow.
Using broad command permissions where task-specific permissions would work.

faq.question: What does this skill help me create?
faq.answer: It helps you write Claude Code skills with clear metadata, structure, examples, and quality checks.

faq.question: Can it create files for me?
faq.answer: It includes setup examples, but file creation should still be approved by the user before writing to disk.

faq.question: Does it work with Codex?
faq.answer: The guidance is useful for Codex-assisted authoring, but the skill format targets Claude Code skills.

faq.question: Does it include security guidance?
faq.answer: It recommends confirmation for critical actions, but permission examples should be narrowed for production skills.

faq.question: When should I add helper scripts?
faq.answer: Add scripts only for reusable, complex, or structured processing that provides clear value.

faq.question: How long should SKILL.md be?
faq.answer: The guide recommends keeping the main file under 500 lines and moving details into references.
